svg.text: xmltodict: opt-in nulls and preserved whitespace for a partner XML feed
A partner feed now marks missing values with xsi:nil and protects padded text with xml:space. The agent extends xmltodict's parse and unparse in /app with two
opt-in options, xsi_nil and xml_space, and leaves every default behaviour exactly as it was.
